name: phd-nd-grad-before-bachelors
description: A Notre Dame 4+1: a senior-year course registered at the GRADUATE level (the transcript's GR column) in the term the B.S. was awarded. §5.2 criterion 2 is read strictly while the department's question sits with the Graduate School (DGS 2026-09-10, evening): no credit earned before the bachelor's degree transfers, not even §3.5's junior/senior-year 6xxxx courses. They are not worthless here — they satisfy BOTH qualifier components, §4.4.1 core knowledge and §4.4.2 specialization, neither of which is credit. With only one such course the §4.4.2 row is still short, and the §5.2 row is NOT APPLICABLE — the course is excluded on its own terms, so the DGS has nothing to decide and the student has nothing to ask for (2026-09-09).

detailIncludes: Nothing here needs a DGS decision
